items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: They used guitar on Conway Schellers. Bigfoot, Billy, and myself. We played all that man

ctx.x: But you play it as a waltz first?

You play it as a waltz. And you turn it around and you jump it. And you jump it in the fox trap. And you dance a little faster. You understand? Like a little two-step. You can make waltz in the two-step too. People enjoy that. What you gonna get to him? Don't play them kind of thing for some kind of college, man. You don't play waltzes for him. We played a picnic for the 20th, last Sunday. We went to Good Citizen Ranch over there. Man, that's all the people want. We play waltzes. We played most waltzes all day.…
Catch a minute fellas right now. You tell them I play them kind of numbers. They'll bet they can't play that.
